name: Hanai Azusa
source:
Bats fifth for the team (batted cleanup in middle school). While originally presented as a hot-headed and rude character, he is later shown to be a relatively smart and observant person, and is unanimously voted to become team captain.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_Windup!#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
